y-m-06-05.title: Kuyini inani elincane kakhulu labafundi umnqobi angaba nalo?
y-m-06-05.topic: Ukufunda idatha: ubudlelwano phakathi kwento ekhethwe kakhulu nenani eliphelele labantu
y-m-06-05.goal: Hlola isitatimende esithi "umnqobi okungenani uyingxenye yenani eliphelele" ngokwenza izibonelo eziphikisayo, futhi uthole ukuthi umnqobi kumele abe nabafundi abangaki okungenani ukuze kube nomnqobi oyedwa kuphela.
y-m-06-05.material:
Abafundi abangu-20 ngamunye ukhethe imenyu eyodwa yokudla kwasemini esikoleni phakathi kwe-tteokbokki, gimbap, ramyeon, nama-dumpling. Umuntu ngamunye ukhethe eyodwa kuphela. Uma kunemenyu eyodwa kuphela ekhethwe kakhulu, lapho imenyu sibiza ngo-"umnqobi." Uma inani elifanayo lilona elikhulu kakhulu, sithi akukho mnqobi.
UJaei wathi, "Imenyu ephumelelayo kumele ikhethwe okungenani abafundi abangu-10. Iyingxenye ka-20."

y-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nquma inombolo eyodwa yamavoti omnqobi kungaba kuhle ukuyihlola kuqala.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.a: Yenza elinye ithebula lapho umnqobi enabafundi abangu-10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.a: Icala elingu-10 selivele lihambisana nesitatimende. Ukuze ukhombe ukuthi likhona yini ithebula eliphikisana nesitatimende, udinga ukufuna elinye icala.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.b: Yenza ithebula lapho yonke imenyu emine inenani elifanayo.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.b: Uma zonke zifana, akukho mnqobi, ngakho awukwazi ukuhlola isitatimende.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.c: Cabanga ukuthi uJaei ulungile futhi ufune isizathu.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.c: Uma uqala emcabangweni wokuthi kulungile futhi ufuna izizathu kuphela, ungase waphuthelwa amacala lapho isitatimende siphuka khona.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.d: Yenza ithebula lapho umnqobi enabafundi abangaphansi kwabangu-10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.d: Lo mcabango uzama ukwenza wena isibonelo esiphikisana nesitatimende.

y-m-06-05.s.s3.explain: Uma umnqobi enabangu-5, imenyu emithathu esele ngayinye inabangu-4 noma abambalwa, ngakho 5+4+4+4=17 akufinyeleli ku-20. Ngo-6, ungenza 6+5+5+4=20. Ngakho umnqobi unabangu-6 okungenani.
